title: FinIR Intent Contract
description: The canonical, versioned interface a natural-language layer emits and the FinIR runtime consumes. Structural validation only; semantic validation (target existence, unit/currency vs. the target's finance type) happens at execution against a specific model. Grounded in the FinIR runtime's apply_intent / what_if / scenarios / run_scenarios.

status.description: valid=safe to execute; ambiguous=understandable but missing required quantitative detail; unsupported=clear but FinIR cannot represent it; invalid=structurally/semantically invalid.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation. Recommended for non-valid statuses.

operations.description: Simultaneous changes to the base model state. Present (possibly empty) for operation intents.

scenarios.description: Named scenarios, each a set of simultaneous operations against the base. Present only for scenario intents.

allOf.description: Non-valid intents are not executable: no operations and no scenarios.
An intent carries either operations or scenarios, not both non-empty.

target.description: The name of a model INPUT node (e.g. 'cogs', 'revenue', 'payment_terms'). Not a canonical metric ontology; FinIR does not resolve aliases. Must exist as an input in the target model at execution time.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code (e.g. 'ZAR', 'USD'). If omitted for a money target, the target's own currency is inherited. If present it must equal the target's currency, else the intent is invalid at execution (no implicit FX).

unit.description: Optional declared unit of the value, aligned with the FinIR type system. Must be compatible with the target's finance type at execution.

oneOf.title: relative_change
oneOf.description: new = current * (1 + value). value is a dimensionless decimal (e.g. -0.08 means -8%).

oneOf.title: set
oneOf.description: new = value (absolute set). unit/currency optional and must match the target's type.

oneOf.title: absolute_change
oneOf.description: new = current + value (additive). Maps to the runtime's additive change. unit/currency optional and must match the target's type.

oneOf.title: range
oneOf.description: A batch sweep: set the target to `steps` absolute values evenly spaced over [min, max]. Executed via run_scenarios. A range operation must be the only operation in its intent (it produces a vectorized batch).
